scoring.answer_normalisation: none (acc); acc_norm divides by choice character length
scoring.context_truncation: left-truncate context so that context+continuation <= max_length; error if the continuation alone does not fit
scoring.method: lm-eval loglikelihood requests; per-request sum of fp32 log-softmax over continuation tokens
scoring.special_tokens: none added; special-token strings in text are encoded as ordinary text

tokenizer.encode_policy: enc.encode(text, disallowed_special=()) -- special-token strings are ordinary text; no BOS/EOT is added
tokenizer.name: cl100k_base
